Q5651.reason: The “as is” clause excludes implied warranties but cannot override the seller’s express description of the car as a 1964 Thunderbird.

Q5672.reason: A self-defense acquittal establishes that the killing was justified, leaving no crime for which the instigator can be liable.

Q8537.reason: A value-neutral definition of punishment avoids building a moral justification into the concept and prejudging whether punishment is justified.
